agent_explanation: Seeded sensor noise (~0.02 max) corrupts pole-angle measurement fed to fixed state-feedback controller. With initial offset theta=0.05 and v=0.23, noisy feedback causes overcorrection (controller forces ~22-26N), pumping energy (E ~20.5 vs E0~1.75) and driving cart velocity to ~5.8 m/s and omega to -6.7 rad/s. Pole diverges monotonically from step 10 (-0.13 rad) to step 15 (-0.45 rad) to step 18 (-0.75 rad) to step 19 (-0.857 rad), violating pole_upright. Removing noise alone stabilizes the run.
